verdict.rationale: Microsoft Entra ID is an identity and access management service, not an AI agent or assistant that consumes tools. Plugging MCP servers into it as an MCP client is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Entra ID acting as an MCP client. The only MCP item (probe-4) points to a Microsoft Learn docs MCP server, which is server-side and not about Entra ID consuming tools.
